ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity white across central lobe surfaces to 25% low-intensity black primarily located at the margins and central notch area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white fields occupy the interior of both lobes; dense black pigmentation forms a continuous border along leading and trailing edges, with vertical 'dripping' extensions from the central notch toward the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 45-50 degrees and high vertical depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 2-8 pixels along the trailing boundary; most pronounced on the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a sigmoid profile, transitioning from concave near the notch to convex towards the mid-lobe, ending in tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular pixel clusters located on the black distal tips (white on black) and scattered smaller dark spots on the interior white field of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous sets of parallel, unaligned linear streaks (rake marks) concentrated on the trailing halves of both lobes, intersecting the primary pigment boundaries.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring across the ventral surface; small irregular notches on the distal edge of the right lobe suggesting prior minor tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent bifurcated black pigment streak originating at the median notch and extending vertically toward the trailing edge margin.
